integrity: The proof separates published ingredients from the new orbit enumeration: Malicki supplies the ordered N-ultrametric bp framework and finite morphism characterization, Petrov supplies the classical finite rooted-tree viewpoint, and the exact orbital counts are derived from the resulting plane cluster trees. A separate verifier independently checks the tree recurrences, endpoint sequences, factorial labeling, and Stirling transform.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns order-preserving ball-preserving automorphisms; the unordered bp-groups have additional finite tree symmetries and are not enumerated here.
The Catalan, Schröder, and bounded-degree plane-tree enumerations are classical; originality is claimed only for their exact interpretation as orbit profiles of these ordered ultrametric bp-groups.
The originality assessment cannot exclude unpublished folklore or results indexed under substantially different terminology.
title: Catalan–Schröder orbit profiles of ordered ultrametric ball-preserving groups
